result.instructions: Tools for SchoolBusTrack, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which buses are running right now, and where are they?"; "List the trips scheduled for today and their status."; "Show the boarding list for this morning's trip on route 4.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SchoolBusTrack data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run schoolbustrack_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run schoolbustrack_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run schoolbustrack_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. schoolbustrack_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: schoolbustrack_ping
tools.title: Check the key
tools.description: Show which school this key acts for, its name, its scopes and its rate limit. Good first call. SchoolBusTrack API: GET /v1/ping.

tools.name: schoolbustrack_list_students
tools.title: List pupils
tools.description: List pupils with their class, campus, route assignment and active flag. Guardian and emergency contact details are never returned. Needs students:read. SchoolBusTrack API: GET /v1/students.
